study.notes: STUDY: DUAL II (NCT01392573), Buse 2014 (Diabetes Care 37:2926-2933), the primary paper of the trial whose 2018 post hoc cardiovascular risk marker abstract is in this group; reached through the institutional route, Table 1 and Results sentences copied into work/fulltext/companion/buse2014_dual2_sentences.txt; double blind randomised 26 week treat to target trial, IDegLira (up to 50 units degludec with 1.8 mg liraglutide) vs insulin degludec capped at 50 units, both with metformin, full analysis set 199 per arm; the contrast isolates the liraglutide component because the degludec doses were equivalent (45 units) at 26 weeks; dose_mg 1.8 is the maximal liraglutide component; hsCRP from the 2018 abstract (estimated treatment ratio); HbA1c and fasting glucose from the paper (ETD with 95% CI, route ci_95, ANCOVA with LOCF); pct_weight_change -2.65 computed by the session: ETD in body weight -2.5 kg over the n weighted baseline weight (95.4*199 + 93.5*199)/398 = 94.45 kg; the degludec cap at 50 units is a design feature that favours the combination on glycaemic endpoints (noted in the paper); sponsor Novo Nordisk (industry); the Vilsboll 2019 subgroup paper (open access, work/fulltext/companion/vilsboll2019_ideglira_cv_markers.txt) reports subgroup effects in figures only

rows.notes: estimated treatment ratio IDegLira vs IDeg at 26 weeks, p not significant; ratio of geometric means on the natural scale (logged by the pipeline); from the 2018 post hoc abstract (hsCRP measured in DUAL II only)

Buse 2014 Results: A1C decreased by 1.9 percent with IDegLira and 0.9 with IDeg, ETD -1.1 (95% CI -1.3 to -0.8) percentage points, P < 0.0001 (primary endpoint, superiority); baseline Table 1 8.7 (0.7) vs 8.8 (0.7); the degludec arm was capped at 50 units
Buse 2014 Results: FPG decreased by 3.5 (SD 2.9) mmol/L with IDegLira and 2.6 (3.3) with IDeg, ETD -0.73 (95% CI -1.19 to -0.27) mmol/L, P = 0.0019; baseline Table 1 9.7 (2.9) vs 9.6 (3.1) mmol/L

json.design: randomised double blind treat to target trial (DUAL II), post hoc cardiovascular risk marker analysis; plus DUAL V (open label vs insulin glargine) without usable numbers
other_markers: blood pressure, heart rate and lipids reported only in subgroup figures of Vilsboll 2019 and in the DUAL II supplement, not captured

rob.justification: DUAL II: randomised double blind (D1, D2 low); attrition not reported in the abstract (D3 some concerns); laboratory outcomes (D4 low); post hoc analysis of risk markers, selection of reported markers possible (D5 some concerns)

doubts: per arm n taken as the full analysis set of 199 per arm
the degludec cap at 50 units limits the comparator, a design feature that favours IDegLira on glycaemic endpoints
json.reason: primary paper of DUAL II reached through the institutional route adds HbA1c and fasting glucose rows with baselines and the weight covariate to the abstract's hsCRP ratio
